title: tildy config v1 (user layer)
description: Config file format. Layers: shared built-in base -> the preset named by `preset` (pastel-powerline when omitted) (its `modules` and `layout` replace the built-in ones) -> this file, deep-merged (objects merge by key, arrays replace). A module here that sets `type` is a full definition and replaces the module of the same id; one without `type` is a partial override merged into it, so `{"schema_version": 1, "preset": "pastel-powerline"}` alone gives the full look. Every object accepts a `$comment` string (the loader ignores it). Extension data belongs under `extensions`. Checks this schema cannot express, enforced by the loader with a JSON path (src/config/validate.rs): the merged config must have `modules` and `layout` (`layout.rows` non-empty); every module must have a `type` after merging; layout ids must exist in modules (or in the built-in config, see validate.py); rule ids unique per module; command modules need non-empty argv; language modules need language; starship modules need module; env_var modules need variable; format/repo_root_format/time_format template syntax; regex compiles; `schema_version` greater than the supported version is rejected as unsupported.

preset.description: Built-in look to start from; names are the presets listed by `tildy capabilities --json` (data.presets). plain: modules joined by spaces, icons in the nerd tier. pastel-powerline: Starship's Pastel Powerline (two rows, powerline segments, then a ❯ line). Role-based presets (powerline, lean, classic, rainbow, minimal) are colored by palette roles and recolored with `palette`.

symbols.description: Symbol tier. auto: $TILDY_SYMBOLS, then terminal/locale detection.

palette.description: Active palette (Starship semantics): a built-in palette (`tildy palette list`: dracula, nord, solarized-dark, solarized-light, one-dark, rose-pine, everforest, kanagawa, gruvbox-dark, tokyo-night, catppuccin-latte, catppuccin-frappe, catppuccin-macchiato, catppuccin-mocha) or one defined under `palettes`. Any style color (style objects and `[...](style)` spans) may name a color of the active palette; palette names win over the 16 color names. Unknown palettes and unknown color names are rejected by the loader with a JSON path. Role-based presets set a default palette.

palettes.description: User palettes: {name: {color name: color}}. Values are concrete colors (they cannot refer to other palette colors). A palette named like a built-in one merges over it key by key, e.g. {"nord": {"accent": "#ff8800"}}. Role-based presets need the roles bg1, bg2, bg3, bg4, bg5, bg6, fg, fg_dim, surface, accent, ok, warn, err, info.

mode.description: compact: collapse to a transient prompt after accepting a line.

add_newline.description: With add_newline: keep the blank line above the collapsed (transient) prompt in the history too, like p10k. false: the collapsed line sits directly under the previous output.

agent.description: Agent status collection. The Zsh adapter runs `programs` through `tildy agent wrap` so their OSC 7501 status reaches agent_status modules in other prompts (docs/agent-status.md).

wrap.description: Wrap `programs` from the Zsh adapter (TILDY_AGENT_WRAP=0 turns it off per shell).

programs.description: Command names to wrap (default: claude, codex, gemini, aider, opencode, amp, goose, copilot, cursor-agent). 1-64 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_.+-], not starting with '-'.

extensions.description: Namespace for extension data; preserved verbatim.

add_newline.description: Starship's add_newline: an empty first prompt line (a blank line between prompts). The transient form keeps the blank line unless history.add_newline is false.

command_timeout_ms.description: Starship's command_timeout: default timeout_ms of provider-backed modules.

color.description: ANSI color name, bright-<name>, grey/gray, default, 0-255 (leading zeros accepted up to 3 digits), #rrggbb, or the name of a color of the active palette (see `palette`).

concrete_color.description: A concrete color: ANSI color name (or purple/bright-purple), bright-<name>, grey/gray, default, 0-255 or #rrggbb.

palette_color_name.description: A palette color name: a letter or '_', then [A-Za-z0-9_-] (at most 64 chars); not bold/dimmed/dim/italic/underline/none.

palette.description: One palette: color name -> concrete color.

foreground.description: Rendered as %F{...}; #rrggbb is passed through (24-bit, Zsh 5.7+).

background.description: Rendered as %K{...}; also the segment color in powerline rows.

dim.description: Raw SGR 2 inside %{...%} (Zsh has no escape for it).

italic.description: Raw SGR 3 inside %{...%} (Zsh has no escape for it).

sym.description: A symbol-like string, or per-tier values {nerd, unicode, ascii}. A missing tier falls back downwards (nerd -> unicode -> ascii); a tier set to "" means nothing. An empty object is accepted by the loader.

field.description: Flat field: git.state, git.branch, git.freshness, git.staged, session.ssh, command.exit, command.duration_ms, cwd.path, ... Missing data makes every operator false.

value.description: A scalar; an array of scalars for `in`; a number for gt/lt/ge/le.

id.description: Unique within its module (not checked by this schema).

left.description: Module ids (must exist in modules, or in the built-in config).

right.description: Module ids (must exist in modules, or in the built-in config). The last row's right side is Zsh's RPROMPT (always plain); an earlier row's right side is drawn right-aligned on that row's line, one column short of the edge, in the row's style (powerline glyphs mirrored), and dropped when it does not fit.

style.description: plain: visible modules joined by single spaces. powerline: each module on its style.background with one space of padding, joined by `separator` drawn in the previous background over the next one (none between equal backgrounds); the last segment ends with the separator over the default background. Hidden modules leave nothing. Applies to `left` and to the `right` of an upper row (mirrored); the last row's `right` (RPROMPT) is always plain.

separator.description: Powerline separator. Default {"nerd": "\ue0b0", "ascii": ">"}. Counts as one column.

start.description: Powerline start cap drawn before the first segment.

end.description: Powerline end cap drawn after the last segment (overrides the default separator end).

subseparator.description: Powerline glyph between neighbours with the same background (default none). Drawn in the next segment's foreground unless it carries a span, e.g. "[\ue0b1](fg:fg_dim)".

module.description: A module definition (a full one when it sets type; a partial override of the same id otherwise). Type-specific fields are checked only when type is present in the same object.

type.description: Module type (capabilities module_types). Required on the merged config; a module without type in a user file is a partial override.

priority.description: When a row is wider than the terminal, modules are dropped by ascending priority (equal priorities: the rightmost first) and reported hidden with no_room. The character module and fills are never dropped; the highest-priority module of a row always stays. Built-in presets: time 10, language versions 20, python/docker/env 30, duration 40, jobs 50, hostname 60, git details 70, git 80, username 90, directory/exit status 100.

rules.description: Evaluated in order; every matching rule's style is overlaid, later wins. Rule ids unique per module (not checked by this schema).

format.description: Text template: $name or ${name} variables, (...) groups dropped when every variable inside is empty, \\ escapes the next character. No nesting, no inline styles. Variables: all types $symbol; directory $path; git $branch_symbol $branch $status; exit_status $code; duration $text $duration; hostname $text $host $user; command/language/python/docker_context $text $version (version_format applied) $env $context and every key of the provider's fields; time $time; username $user; jobs $count. Defaults: directory "$path", git "($branch_symbol )$branch( $status)", exit_status "$symbol $code", duration/hostname "$text", command "($symbol )$text", language "$symbol( $version)", python "$symbol( $version)( \\($env\\))", docker_context "$symbol( $context)", character "$symbol", time "($symbol )$time", jobs "$symbol$count", username "$symbol" when a symbol is set else "$user". Template syntax is checked by the loader (src/config/template.rs), not by this schema.

symbol.description: $symbol. Defaults: language/python/docker_context Nerd icons (unicode/ascii text fallbacks), jobs ✦, character ❯ (ascii >), exit_status ✗ (ascii x).

success_style.description: character/exit_status: overlaid when the last command exited 0.

error_style.description: character/exit_status: overlaid when the last command failed.

error_symbol.description: character: symbol when the last command failed.

text.description: text: the literal text (required for text modules).

os_symbols.description: os: map from OS name to symbol.

number_threshold.description: jobs: show the count from this number of jobs.

show_always.description: username: show even when not over SSH and not root.

time_format.description: time: %R %H %M %S %I %p %Y %m %d %F %T %r %%. Other % sequences are rejected by the loader.

truncation_length.description: directory: keep the last N path components (the home symbol counts; 0 = no truncation). git: cut the branch name to N characters plus truncation_symbol.

truncation_symbol.description: directory: prefix of a truncated or repo-relative path. Default …/ (ascii .../). git: appended to a cut branch name (first character; default …).

substitutions.description: directory: keys containing / replace the longest matching leading path (e.g. ~/work/x); other keys replace whole path components. A value empty for the current tier disables that entry.

truncate_to_repo.description: directory: inside a repository whose root is not $HOME, start the path at the repo root name (Starship). When false, truncation never cuts above the repo root.

repo_root_format.description: directory: format of the repo-root part of the path (template syntax as in format; checked by the loader).

ignore_branches.description: git: branch names that never show.

only_attached.description: git: only show when HEAD is attached to a branch.

status_symbols.description: git: when set, $status is Starship's $all_status$ahead_behind: conflicted, stashed, deleted, renamed, modified, staged, untracked, then diverged|ahead|behind. Unset keys default to = $ ✘ » ! + ? ⇕ ⇡ ⇣ (ASCII fallbacks). When absent, $status is tildy's summary (±changes =conflicts ↑ahead ↓behind).

up_to_date.description: $ahead_behind when the branch has an upstream and is neither ahead nor behind (default empty).

show_counts.description: git: append counts to status symbols.

show_state.description: git: show an in-progress operation like Starship's git_state, e.g. (REBASING 2/5).

state_labels.description: git: label per operation (defaults: MERGING, REBASING, CHERRY-PICKING, REVERTING, BISECTING, AM).

state_style.description: git: style of the state label. Default bold yellow.

language.description: language modules (required): entry of the built-in table (detection, version command, symbol).

module.description: starship modules (required): name passed to `starship module`; output is shown as-is (no padding added in powerline rows).

detect_files.description: command/language/python/docker_context/starship/direnv: overrides the provider's detection list (entries of the current directory).

detect_extensions.description: command/language/python/docker_context/starship/direnv: overrides the provider's detection list (entries of the current directory).

detect_folders.description: command/language/python/docker_context/starship/direnv: overrides the provider's detection list (entries of the current directory).

argv.description: command modules (required): the command to run.

regex.description: command modules: the first capture group (or whole match) of this regex on the output becomes the text/version. Compiled by the loader (Rust regex syntax); not checked here.

timeout_ms.description: provider-backed modules (command, language, python, docker_context, starship, package, git_commit, git_metrics, localip, memory_usage, sudo, direnv). Default: the config's command_timeout_ms, else 500.

cache_ttl_s.description: provider-backed modules (command, language, python, docker_context, starship, package, git_commit, git_metrics, localip, memory_usage, sudo, direnv).

read_only.description: directory: shown by $read_only when the cwd is not writable. Default 🔒 (ascii RO).

read_only_style.description: directory: style of $read_only; unset, it takes the style of the span it sits in.

fish_style_pwd_dir_length.description: directory: truncated components are shown abbreviated to N characters instead of dropped (Starship's fish style; off with substitutions).

use_logical_path.description: directory: true shows the shell's logical cwd; false resolves symlinks.

repo_root_style.description: directory: style of $repo_root. Setting it splits the path at a visible repository root: repo_root_format, else format with $path read as $before_root_path$repo_root$path.

before_repo_root_style.description: directory: style of $before_root_path in the split form.

always_show_remote.description: git: show $remote_name/$remote_branch even when the upstream branch has the local branch's name.

ignore_submodules.description: git/git_metrics: ignore changes inside submodules (status --ignore-submodules=dirty; diff --ignore-submodules).

min_time.description: duration: hide below this many milliseconds.

trim_at.description: hostname: cut the name (the shell's $HOST) at the first occurrence; "" shows the full name.

aliases.description: hostname/username: replace a name by another (hostname: after trim_at).

detect_env_vars.description: hostname/username/direnv: forwarded env variables that show the module; !NAME hides it while NAME is set.

utc_time_offset.description: time: local, or hours east of UTC between -24 and 24 (e.g. -5, 5.5).

time_range.description: time: START-END in HH:MM:SS (either side may be empty): show only inside; - always.

success_symbol.description: exit_status: symbol after success; when non-empty the module also shows for exit 0.

sigint_symbol.description: exit_status: with map_symbol and recognize_signal_code, for exit 130.

signal_symbol.description: exit_status: with map_symbol and recognize_signal_code, for exits 129-255.

symbol_threshold.description: jobs: show $symbol from this number of jobs.

display_private.description: package: show the version of a package.json marked private.

commit_hash_length.description: git_commit: characters of $hash (above 7 runs git rev-parse).

only_detached.description: git_commit: show only on a detached HEAD.

tag_disabled.description: git_commit: false fills $tag (tag_symbol + the nearest tag, from git describe --tags).

tag_max_candidates.description: git_commit: commits the tag may be behind HEAD (0 = exact match).

added_style.description: git_metrics: style of +added in $diff. Default bold green.

deleted_style.description: git_metrics: style of -deleted in $diff. Default bold red.

threshold.description: shlvl: show from this SHLVL (default 2). memory_usage: show from this RAM percentage (default 75; -1 = always).

repeat_offset.description: shlvl: repeat the symbol this many times fewer.

ssh_only.description: localip: show only when the shell forwards SSH_CONNECTION.

allowed_msg.description: direnv: $allowed for an allowed rc file.

not_allowed_msg.description: direnv: $allowed for an rc file not allowed yet.

denied_msg.description: direnv: $allowed for a denied rc file.

loaded_msg.description: direnv: $loaded when the rc file is loaded.

unknown_msg.description: nix_shell: $state when detected by the heuristic.

heuristic.description: nix_shell: treat a PATH with /nix/store entries as a nix shell of unknown state.

indicators.description: shell: indicator per shell name (defaults: Starship's bsh fsh zsh psh ...).

unknown_indicator.description: shell: indicator for a shell without one.

state_symbols.description: agent_status: $symbol per state of the highlighted record (OSC 7501 states); unset states use the built-in tiers.

max_width.description: agent_status: $msg is cut to this many columns (default 40).

starship_config.description: Absolute source TOML for a Starship bridge. When omitted, Starship uses its environment/default config.
